annotations.description: Prometheus has been unable to scrape the controlled metrics endpoint for two minutes.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job or instance matcher only; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 4h; never global.

annotations.description: At least one due pending Run has remained dispatchable for fifteen minutes.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job matcher only; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 4h; never global.

annotations.description: A validated run_dead_lettered event is present in the fixed fifteen-minute audit window.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job matcher only after evidence capture; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 1h.

annotations.summary: LLMBenchLab recorded a governance integrity error
annotations.description: A validated governance_integrity_error event is present in the fixed fifteen-minute audit window.
annotations.silence_policy: Do not routinely silence; capture evidence and remediate the durable governance facts.

annotations.description: At least one database governance scope is marked overdrawn.
annotations.silence_policy: Do not routinely silence; capture evidence and reconcile the durable governance ledger.

annotations.summary: LLMBenchLab Redis notification queue is degraded
annotations.description: The configured non-authoritative Redis notification queue has been unavailable for two minutes.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job matcher only; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 4h; never global.

annotations.summary: LLMBenchLab has fewer live Workers than configured
annotations.description: Database-time Worker progress shows a live process shortfall for two minutes.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job matcher only during controlled maintenance; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 1h.

annotations.summary: LLMBenchLab expired lease recovery is slow
annotations.description: The oldest currently expired running lease exceeds the configured recovery alert threshold.
annotations.silence_policy: Narrow job matcher only after recovery ownership is established; owner, ticket, and expiry required; maximum 15m.
